column1: # Add custom rules below this line
# The rules below are intentionally conservative and scoped to the dev API.
# Rationale: some header-oriented findings are primarily browser-focused and can
# generate noise for a JSON API. We keep them as WARN so they remain visible in
# reports but (depending on scan configuration) are less likely to fail CI.
# X-Frame-Options Header Missing (clickjacking protection; typically less relevant for pure APIs)
# Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set (primarily for browsers; not typical for APIs)
# CSP Scanner (Policy Errors) (often noisy when CSP is not used)
# Content Cacheability (often flagged on APIs; treat as warning until tuned per endpoint)
